text:
sophia: Quick design review — dark mode palette feels off in the console. Syntax highlighting looks washed on the code panel and the metric charts are ambiguous (orange vs warning red). Screenshot: https://img.redwood.local/ux/lumen-palette-sample.png

maya: I noticed that too. The code background is currently #0f1720 which makes mid-tone tokens lose pop. We should bump the code-bg darker or brighten token hues. Also need to check WCAG contrast for default text (aim >= 4.5:1 for body). :eyes:

jamal: +1. Also the orange series on charts is visually similar to our alert color when shown small — suggest swapping orange -> teal for the primary metric and reserve orange for alerts/warnings. Teal hex I like: #3DD6C9.

akshay: Agree on teal. Another accessibility nit: color alone isn't reliable. For lines/bars add subtle patterns or 1px stroke so they remain distinguishable in print/grayscale and for deuteranopia. We have a colorblind simulator test in the repo if someone wants to run it.

frank: Small product copy point — on the usage chart legend we currently say "Token use" which confuses some folks. Can we rename to "Token count" or "Tokens processed"? Token use sounds like billing to PMs.

maya: mock CSS proposal (very rough):
```css
:root {
  --code-bg: #0b0f13; /* darker */
  --code-text: #e6eef6;
  --token-func: #7bd8ff; /* functions */
  --token-str: #ffd58a; /* strings */
  --token-key: #b6e48a; /* keywords */
  --chart-primary: #3dd6c9; /* teal */
  --chart-secondary: #8aa4ff;
}
```
Feels better in my local preview.

design-bot: Contrast check results for suggested vars: code-bg(#0b0f13) vs code-text(#e6eef6) => 7.2:1 (PASS), token-str(#ffd58a) on code-bg => 3.8:1 (WARN for small text), token-func(#7bd8ff) on code-bg => 5.1:1 (PASS). Recommend increasing token-str or using bold for strings.

jamal: For charts: if we adopt teal + blue + purple, keep saturation lower for large areas and bump when used for small lines. Example palette: [#3DD6C9, #6F8CFF, #B08CFF, #FFD58A] (use last only if semantic warning).

akshay: I'll run the colorblind + grayscale checks tomorrow and propose patterned fills for bar charts.

frank: I'll change legend copy to "Tokens processed" and run it by analytics for consistency with billing labels.

sophia: Thanks all — plan: maya to land token color tweaks + CSS vars, akshay to run accessibility sims and propose patterns, jamal to update chart palette tokens, frank to update legend copy. I'll review in the next pass and we can ship a patch to the beta console. Action items assigned. :thumbsup:
